comment: JP 1.27 (BCJS30089) has no game-address instruction patches yet: 'patches' is empty and pipeline-jp127.toml lifts without --insn-patches. 'us_1_03_mapping' maps each US 1.03 patch (config/insn-patches-1.03.json) to its JP address by matching masked code around it (tools/jp_addr_map.py); every one of them is an optional feature (HSG_TWEAKS boot menu, ultrawide culling, HSG_FPS) whose runtime side stands down on the JP program (libs/system/hsg_program.c).
